title: Terrain Conqueror (v4)
description: A physics-based off-road driving game where you conquer increasingly rugged terrain, collect coins, and upgrade your vehicle between levels.
prompt: You have created a decent start at a terrain game, where you track across it in a car, the issue is, the gravity appears to be too strong, and the car bounces far too high / aggressively, we need to tone down these functions so the vehicle has less gravity, and the bounce less aggressive. The vehicle flipping over should not be a fail either, only if the part of the vehicle that is NOT the wheels touches the ground or ceiling.
